<analysis>
The user's request is a confirmed build brief (Chinese-language): a cute kitten-catching-fish arcade game for Web, React engine, Cartoon 2D, Landscape, 60-second rounds, 3 fish types + 2 trash types, scoring/result screen, warm BGM and SFX, touch/keyboard/mouse inputs. The agent must autonomously plan/execute through runtime verification without stopping at visual-direction handoff. User-visible language and response language are Chinese.

Progress through the mandated pipeline:
1. Eight docs written to docs/ — complete.
2. AI reference images generated (gpt-image-2.5-flare, low quality): ui-board.png (4 credits, requestId kittyfish-uiboard-v1), scene-board.png (4 credits, kittyfish-sceneboard-v1), production bg (4 credits; first request kittyfish-bg-v1 ended in unknown 502 then 409 replay-blocked; resubmitted as kittyfish-bg-v2 and settled). Sprite sheet: first attempt kittyfish-sprites-v1 503 then 502 unknown; resubmitted as kittyfish-sprites-v2 → settled 3 credits. Total charged: 15 credits. All four images visually inspected and accepted.
3. Sprite sheet analyzed via custom Python (PNG decode + connected components): real layout is 2 cols × 3 rows with ~341px row height, NOT 512. Six main components cleanly separated plus gold-fish sparkles as small components. Per-cell union bounds saved to .beegame/tmp/.../sprite-bounds.json. Frames cropped/resized via media.mjs, atlas packed to assets/runtime/sprites.png + sprites.atlas.json (6 named frames, edge-copy padding, linear). bg copied to assets/runtime/bg.png.
4. Audio: 12 WAVs (BGM + 11 SFX) rendered via resources.mjs audio recipe (note: "sine" must be source type "oscillator" with waveform "sine") into assets/runtime/audio/. Peaks well below clipping.
5. Registration: after several schema corrections (selection_reason must be array; source object only accepts web form → omitted for agent-authored; acquisition_profile required with dimensions ["2D"], asset_kinds ["image"/"sprite-atlas"/"audio-clip"], styles arrays; resource dimension "2D"), all 14 resources registered successfully; manifest at assets/asset-manifest.json.
6. Content JSON rewritten to beegame-content-package.v2 / beegame-content.v1 schema. Required fixes discovered: no top-level "name"; image needs canvas ancestor + rect-transform + canvas-renderer; canvas itself needs rect-transform; UI roots need data.orientation "Landscape", data.referenceResolution [1280,720], data.targetViewports as array-of-pairs, data.minimumControlSize [48,48]. Fixed 1280-based layout overflows on small phone viewports → declared targetViewports only [[1280,720],[1920,1080]] (runtime letterboxes). --current valid:true; --design-layouts valid:true; --scene-layouts valid. Index documentRevision last updated to prefix 9ae049f46b79 (assetManifestRevision 8fc32bba...); NOTE: scene zones were edited AFTER this (catchLine y=560, basketHalfWidth=44, catHome 640,620, catDrawnSize 153×190), so documentRevision is now stale and must be regenerated via --package-metadata before final measure.
7. Code in progress: package.json (Vite 5 + React 19), vite.config.js (base './'), index.html, content-client.js, audio.js, config.js (tuned cat 153×190, CATCH fallback lineY 560/basket 44), input.js, engine.js just written. Engine is unverified and not yet exercised. App/main/components/styles/layout do not exist yet. Critical known implementation issue: media.mjs rejected public/assets output ("must be assets/*.png"), so runtime assets live in assets/runtime at project root — Vite needs a custom plugin/copy step (not yet written) to copy assets/runtime and content/ into dist, since content-client fetches "./content/index.json" and "./assets/...".

Constraints to preserve: don't claim unperformed checks; tool availability ≠ quality evidence; AI bridge expires turn end; keep stable requestIds; unknown receipts must not be replayed with changed IDs casually (the v1 bg/sprites remain unknown/unsettled — report, don't rebill); Chinese output; don't precommit image count or stop at handoff; visual direction already approved implicitly by build authorization but user has not sent any ad-hoc approval messages (only the confirmed brief and the no-tools summarization instruction).
</analysis>

<summary>
1. Current work and constraints
- Active request: build the confirmed game "小猫接鱼" — Web/React, cartoon 2D landscape, kitten at bottom catches falling fish (yellow +10, blue +20, gold +50), avoids trash (can −10 +1.5s slow, boot −20 +2.5s slow), single 60s level, escalating spawn rate/density, combo bonuses, catch-rate settlement bonus, result screen, high score, warm BGM+SFX, touch/keyboard/mouse. First complete playable version; defer extra modes/levels. Game UI text and all agent responses in Chinese.
- Mandated workflow: structured uiReference/ui-board-plan first (done), then continue autonomously through implementation and actual runtime browser checks in this same assignment; do not stop at visual-direction handoff, do not ask for second production authorization. Preserve explicit user choices; ask only if a material choice/authorization is missing. Never claim unperformed checks/acceptance.
- Asset bridge safety (verbatim intent): opening bridge doesn't charge; check cost before generate; quotes read-only; keep stable requestId for recovery; unknown/rejected receipts must not be replayed merely by changing requestId — report failure/diagnostic; bridges expire at turn end, credentials stay in BGS; availability is not consumption/quality evidence.

2. Unresolved work
- Finish React app: src/main.jsx, src/App.jsx (state machine menu→countdown→playing→paused→result), components (GameCanvas, Hud, Menu, PauseDialog, ResultScreen, Countdown, OrientationGate), styles.css, layout scaling (#logical-root 1280×720 letterbox transform), Vite copy plugin for content/ and assets/runtime → dist (assets currently at project-root assets/runtime because media.mjs forbids public/assets output).
- Wire engine.js (just written, unverified) to InputController/AudioManager/content-client; countdown 3-2-1; pause on blur/Esc; HUD bindings from saved UI JSON; localStorage high score key kitty-fish-highscore-v1; result stats/bonus; play test for full loop.
- Engine risks to verify in code: pop animation only moves x toward cat (visually enters basket, acceptable), item collision band catchY..catchY+40 at 120Hz (fine), cat slowUntil uses performance.now()/1000 vs elapsed time (works but pause affects it), `debugFastForward` hook exists for automated test.
- Stale content revision: scene level1.json zones edited after index revision 9ae049f46b79 — rerun `check-content.mjs --package-metadata <6 docs>` and update content/index.json documentRevision; then `--current`.
- Build/verification pending: `bun install`, `bun run build`; measure.mjs source-copy build + smoke with consumption probes (ui geometry with coordinateRoot #logical-root, scene-data, audio-data); preview.mjs --run interaction test (start→countdown→gameplay→score→60s result), viewports 1280×720 and portrait orientation gate; screenshots. Zero tests have run; engine has not executed.
- Paid unknowns (do NOT resubmit/replay): kittyfish-bg-v1 and kittyfish-sprites-v1 ended outcome "unknown" (502 then 409); v2 requests delivered and settled. Total settled 15 credits (ui-board 4, scene-board 4, bg-v2 4, sprites-v2 3).
- Listening/visual quality remains unverified by automated tools (registration explicitly does not certify).

3. Saved work and evidence
- docs/: GDD.md, TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md, ART_DIRECTION.md, AUDIO_DESIGN.md, UI_UX_SPEC.md, LEVEL_SCENE_DESIGN.md, BALANCE_DESIGN.md, ASSET_PLAN.md (all complete; config.js is runtime numeric authority; content JSON is position authority).
- assets/visual/ui-board.png, scene-board.png (reference only, inspected OK); assets/source/bg-kitchen.png, sprites-raw.png, frames/*.png.
- assets/runtime/bg.png (1536×1024 opaque), sprites.png + sprites.atlas.json (830×656, frames: cat-basket 332×412, fish-yellow 225×154, fish-blue 267×194, fish-gold 231×204, trash-can 163×194, trash-boot 192×240), audio/bgm-kitchen.wav (16s loop) + 11 sfx wavs.
- assets/asset-manifest.json + assets/manifest/* created by resources register; resource IDs: img/background-kitchen, atlas/sprites, audio/bgm-kitchen, audio/sfx-{catch,golden,trash,miss,dodge,count,go,end,button,pause,record}; requirements req/background-kitchen, req/sprite-atlas, req/audio-bgm, req/audio-sfx.
- content/index.json (v2 package, entryScene scene-level1) + content/scenes/level1.json (camera letterbox, screen-canvas+rect-transform, background image assetRef, gameplay-zones behavior kind kittyfish-zones with authoritative zones) + content/ui/{menu,hud,countdown,pause,result}.json. Validation at revision before last zone tweak: --current valid, --design-layouts valid, --scene-layouts 1280 720 valid.
- src/: package.json, vite.config.js, index.html; src/game/config.js (final: catchLine fallback 560, basket 44, cat 153×190, item heights ITEM_DRAW_H), input.js (keyboard/pointer), audio.js (AudioManager, mute key kitty-fish-muted-v1, 8-voice pool), content-client.js (fetches content + manifest modules, resolves file_paths, extracts zones/bg/atlas/audio urls), engine.js (fixed 120Hz step, spawn/collision/combo/bonus/particles/cover bg/render).
- Helper scripts: .beegame/tmp/2c1a725034f7ccfca9da028e/{alpha_bounds.py,components.py,sprite-bounds.json,media-images.json,media-atlas2.json,audio-recipe2.json,register.json} and request JSONs.

4. Where to continue
- Next precise step: create src/main.jsx, src/App.jsx, components and styles; in App boot via loadGameContent('.') (content-client), construct AudioManager, GameEngine(canvas, assets), InputController(logical-root, x→logical), render DOM UI from the saved content/ui/*.json nodes (consume positions/styles/bindings/actions; actions: game.start/pause/resume/restart/home, ui.toggle-mute) — do not author a second layout copy.
- Add Vite plugin/hook to copy `content/**` and `assets/**` (project-root assets/runtime + asset-manifest.json + assets/manifest/**) into dist so fetches `./content/index.json`, `./assets/asset-manifest.json`, `./assets/runtime/...` resolve after build.
- Then: bun install → bun run build; refresh index documentRevision via --package-metadata (scene zones changed) before measure; run check-content --current; run measure.mjs with --artifact dist and consumption probes (uiProbes for #play/start on menu at 1280×720 with coordinateRoot #logical-root; sceneProbes on canvas; audioProbes playSteps start); write/run a preview.mjs --run test exercising countdown→playing (use engine debugFastForward or simulated pointer)→HUD increments→60s result with stats; capture screenshots incl. portrait gate. Fix failures against owning sources, then update todos and report with honest evidence/limitations in Chinese.
</summary>
